summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the Receptionist-Doctor Binding feature. All 6 backend tests passed (100% success rate). The feature correctly implements: (1) Doctor creates receptionist with created_by field set to doctor's ID, (2) Receptionist sees ONLY their doctor's patients, (3) Receptionist creates patient with owner_id set to doctor, (4) Receptionist can manage appointments for their doctor, (5) Data isolation between doctors works correctly.
passed_tests: Test 1: Doctor creates receptionist - created_by field is set to doctor's ID
Test 2: Receptionist sees ONLY their doctor's patients (verified via API)
Test 3: Receptionist creates patient - owner_id is set to doctor's ID (not receptionist)
Test 4: Receptionist can create/update/delete appointments for their doctor
Test 5: Data isolation - ReceptionistA cannot see DoctorB's patients (returns 404)
Test 6: Receptionist can see and manage doctor's existing appointments

create_receptionist endpoint (Line 383) sets created_by to current_user['id']
All patient/appointment queries use get_owner_id_for_user() for data isolation
Receptionist data access properly scoped to their doctor's data
